title: Ctrl+T always puts the cursor in the new terminal's name box, in every view
summary: Ctrl+T now keeps trying for about a second to put the cursor in the new terminal card's name box, in every view, and Enter in that box launches the terminal.
friction: Running three dev agents plus reviewers at once left the machine with about 0.02 GB free: local full Vitest runs timed out (12 tests on a main baseline, 3 files on a branch) and one reviewer could not run the build. CI stayed the reliable suite; three full local suites at once is more than this machine holds.
lessons_learned: Every parallel story that changes user-visible behaviour appends to docs/runbook.md, so the second and third merges of a batch hit an add/add conflict there and cost a dev round each; expect it, or pick at most one runbook-touching story per batch.
